author: ctfdn_official
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork. (Yes, we're aware AI art has appeared on our channel before, and we'd love to return to using human artists full-time once the budget supports it, and this is part of that plan.)

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com

Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

Know a talented artist who would be a great fit? Tag them below or share this post to help us find them!

author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Fantasy Miniatures
content:
WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️

The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches.

👉We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. If you enjoy designing characters and monsters but don't like spending weeks on the same design then this is for you. You will be able to work on many designs and someone who works quick will thrive in this role. The quicker you work the more we can send you.

Creativity is extremely valuable and there is lots of room for creative freedom. People who don't work quickly, or are unable to take direction and revisions won't do well in this position.

The following skill sets are required.
✔️in depth understanding of human anatomy
✔️in depth understanding of creature and animal anatomy
✔️great drawing and sketching skills
✔️understanding of dynamic posing

⚠️ IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ:
All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio.

We do not accept applications, review portfolios, answer hiring questions, or conduct any part of the recruitment process through Instagram, including DMs and comments.

Please review the full job description and follow the application instructions provided there.

Good luck!

author: puffballstudios
title: Artist Call for Abida - Line Art Finishing Artist
content:
📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢

Doston, Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2

We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel.

What you'll be working on:
○ Finishing and refining line art / inks
○ Supporting the completion of illustrated pages
○ Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches
○ Working from existing artwork, layouts, and visual references under Lead Artist's direction

You should apply if you have strong character drawing and anatomy skills, a solid understanding of perspective, movement, and exaggeration, with clean, confident linework.
You should also be comfortable adapting to an existing visual style and maintaining consistency across characters, environments, and sequential panels.

If this sounds like you, send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: saltoparticipation
title: Call for Illustrators - Democracy Stickers
content:
🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life!

SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator, artist, or illustration-led organisation to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, active citizenship, inclusion, critical thinking, community, cooperation, access to information, and having a voice.

The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers shared across the SALTO PI community. We are open to different styles and want to give the selected illustrator plenty of creative freedom to bring their own ideas and artistic identity to the collection.

🌍 Open to illustrators worldwide
💶 Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment
🎨 Approximately 10–15 original illustrations
📅 Application deadline: 8 November 2026
✅ Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026
🚫 Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted.

Applications should include a short professional profile, selected portfolio, brief creative direction, and one example or early concept. A simple sketch, rough concept, or mood board is enough. We do not expect substantial unpaid creative work.

Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio

Know an illustrator whose work could bring a fresh perspective to participation? Share this call with them!

#CallForIllustrators #Illustration #OpenCall #CreativeOpportunity #SALTOPI #Participation #Democracy #artist #jobopportunity

author: smorgasburg
title: Looking for Local Illustrator for 2027 Flyer
content:
Smorgasburg, through your eyes. 🎨 Calling all local artists!

We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations.

We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective.

Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome.

The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20.
